items.name: Escape
items.benefit: Help website visitors leave an in-app browser.
supported_environments: Websites with JavaScript; scripted browser checks, limited physical-device evidence
requirements: A website you can edit; JavaScript enabled
use: Add to the selected website: <script src="/escape-webview.js" data-auto data-analytics="off" defer></script>
Inspect /escape/demo/ for a forced demonstration. Test on the actual target app/device before claiming support.
items.storage: A self-hosted widget reads browser context. Install explicitly into your website; Usual never deploys it.
items.network: Self-hosted script; provided snippet disables analytics. User actions may navigate to the selected URL. No Usual backend or model calls.
items.example: Show a visitor browser-menu instructions and a copyable link. iOS needs a user action.

tested: Synthetic browser user agents and DOM; explicit upstream patch hash; no new physical-device checks.
pending: Real device coverage is limited; synthetic user agents do not prove device behavior.
